text: This report provides an update on expansion of Toronto’s licensed child care system, including progress on the implementation of the Canada-wide Early Learning and Child Care (CWELCC) system locally; the impact of the cost-based funding formula; and capital expansion planning and progress since the introduction of the Early Learning and Child Care Infrastructure Fund.

City Council on November 12 and 13, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the provincial and federal governments to provide additional and sustained capital and operating funding to support progress towards Toronto's Canada-wide Early Learning and Child Care expansion targets. 2. City Council direct the General Manager, Children’s Services to continue to prioritize future capital investments and the necessary operating funding from the provincial or federal government to support the expansion of child care services in high-inequity neighbourhoods, in alignment with legislation and provincial guidelines. 3.
